source: Final verification output of `make bench-kernels` on the integrated mainline; summary transcribed from the harness stdout.
scope: native detect() kernel-path benchmark over one fixed 100 MB synthetic chunk
scope_note: Kernel-scope timing only. It excludes ingestion, queueing, object storage, worker commit and dashboard overhead. Do not read it as an end-to-end platform speedup.
timing_policy: best time of three repetitions, matching scripts/run_bench.sh
caveats: Best-of-three is reported, not a median or IQR; microbenchmark variance remains possible.
Generated from a fixed synthetic dataset, not a representative production corpus.
Equivalent workload scope only; compare kernel time with kernel time, not with end-to-end time.
The staging/VRAM JSON is a memory diagnostic, not a CPU/GPU speedup result.
